alternative.src/fields.mjs: export function valueAt(values,path){return path.reduce((v,k)=>v!==null&&typeof v==='object'&&Object.hasOwn(v,k)?v[k]:undefined,values);}export function missing(v){return [undefined,null,''].includes(v);}

mutants.name: truthy-when
mutants.replacement: import {valueAt,missing} from './fields.mjs';export function validate(values,rules){const errors=[];for(const r of rules){if(r.when&&Boolean(valueAt(values,r.when.path))!==Boolean(r.when.equals))continue;const value=valueAt(values,r.path);if(r.required&&missing(value))errors.push({path:[...r.path],code:'required',message:r.label+' is required'});else if(r.minLength!==undefined&&!missing(value)&&value.length<r.minLength)errors.push({path:[...r.path],code:'minLength',message:r.label+' is too short'});}return errors;}export function errorSummary(errors){const out=[],seen=new Set();for(const e of errors){const key=JSON.stringify(e.path);if(seen.has(key))continue;seen.add(key);out.push({target:'field-'+e.path.map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'),text:e.message});}return out;}
